title: House Democrats Set Nov. 11 Deadline for Trump to Disclose Official AI Chatbot Records

summary:
President Donald Trump has been asked to preserve and disclose the full history of his interactions with a range of artificial intelligence assistants as part of a congressional inquiry into whether these tools have been used to execute government functions. In a letter obtained by Politico, the House Judiciary and Oversight Committees requested the records of all prompts and responses from chatbots including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, in addition to Elon Musk's Grok.

The demand for records, led by ranking members Jamie Raskin and Robert Garcia, includes a Nov. 11 deadline for the White House to provide a formal briefing on the matter. The legislators are specifically investigating reports that Trump used Grok to gauge potential reactions in Venezuela following the capture of President Nicolás Maduro, raising concerns about the influence of AI on sensitive military and foreign policy decisions.

selectedTweets.text:
The ranking members of the House Judiciary and Oversight Committees have written a letter to President Trump asking whether he has been soliciting advice from Grok in order to help carry out his official duties as President of the United States.

They also demanded that he preserve any prompts sent to Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, as well as outputs in response to those prompts, that were 'submitted to AI chatbots in carrying out your constitutional, statutory, or other official or ceremonial duties.'

The letter was provided by Politico.
